transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my wife thought I should come in. We've been having some disagreements lately. 

She says her late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but... I don't know. For the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It’s like there’s a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t just say directly. 

So... she wanted me to talk to someone about it. That's why I'm here.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or messages when there was no one around to make them?
No. I mean... no. I don't hear voices or anything like that. It's just... what I already told you.
Over this past year, have you had persistent periods where you felt very down, depressed, or lost interest in your usual activities?
No... not really. I haven't felt depressed. I still do my usual things, go to work... teach. I mean, the situation is stressful, obviously, but... no. I'm not depressed. I'm fine.
Aside from your wife, have you generally felt suspicious of the motives of friends, colleagues, or others throughout your life?
No. I... no. I get along fine with my colleagues at the university. I don't really have issues with other people. It's just... what I said before.
